summary: The recorded base reproduced the missing safety default by accepting 100 normalized images when no explicit multimodal limit was configured. The exact candidate adds an inherited per-processor default, an InternVL override, a validated server override, early base-loader rejection, and common serving-path enforcement for processor bypasses. Candidate and independent tests passed from checkout source paths.

tests.what_was_measured: At base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, confirmed no IMAGE_NUM_LIMITATION and confirmed common serving validation accepted 100 images without an explicit limit.
Exact candidate regression and compatibility suite: 20 passed, 26 parameterized subtests passed.
Independent default boundary, configured higher and zero limits, other-modality configuration, pre-decode rejection, and common serving-dispatch protection.
All candidate-modified Python source files compile.

gpu_execution_evidence: The feature is a Python request-count guard that rejects before image decode/model execution; no numerical kernel or model output is changed. No multimodal model weights were available, and the supplied tiny Llama fixture is text-only and cannot qualify this contract.
remaining_limitations: No model-weight HTTP multimodal run was performed; the available tiny Llama fixture cannot test image processing.
No GPU numerical reference was applicable because the candidate changes only pre-decode Python validation.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes no C++, HIP, CUDA, FlyDSL, compiler, Torch, or ROCm source.
InternVL is the only architecture with an explicit override; all other processors conservatively inherit the issue-proposed default of five.
